title: fix(record-context): a related object's read that fails is a failure, not a refusal
body:
Fixes #37463

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：AI 用资料包读一条记录时，如果关联对象那一步因为故障（比如数据库抖动）读不出来，现在回答「内部错误」，不再谎称「无权访问」；对有权限的拒绝、以及「数据源暂不可用」这类本来就有明确说法的故障，照旧原样回答。用户无感于正常路径。
- 为什么做：属于「记录级 AI 问答」专题，替核对 AI 回答引用的一方解决分不清「没权限」和「出故障」的问题，故障时引用会被如实上报而不是悄悄丢掉。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是某次故障被报成「内部错误」，调用方可以重试，运维在服务器日志里每次都能看到故障原因；回答里不会多说出任何对象、字段或包的名字，改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

`get_record_context` (`packages/services/service-record-context`) reads each related object of a pack before it answers. At four of those reads, a throw that was **not** a refusal (an outage, a bug) was misanswered. At three of them it came back as `PERMISSION_DENIED` 403, so the citation verifier (`verifyRecordCitations`) read it as a refusal and dropped every citation without a report:

| Site | Before (a failure) | After |
|---|---|---|
| step 4a, `assertApiExposed` failure that is not a coded refusal | 403 unnamed | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` |
| step 4a, `servedObjectDefinitionOf(child)` throwing | 403 unnamed | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` |
| `publishedOf`, published-definition read throwing | 403 unnamed | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` |
| the child list query, an uncoded throw (the `/data` door answers it `500 Internal server error` and nothing else) | the raw error, which the doors answered 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR`, the original at the foot of the stack |
| the child list query, a fault the door codes (`ERR_DATASOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` 503, `DATABASE_ERROR`, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` 501, a declared 5xx with its sentence) | the raw error, answered with the door's own code and sentence | unchanged: rethrown untouched |

- **One helper, one line.** `refusedOrFailed` decides refusal vs failure at all four sites. At the three object-level sites it asks `isCodedRefusal` (in `record-context-tools.ts`, not on the package entry): the ADR-0112 line, a non-empty string `code` plus a declared 4xx status (`.status`, then `.statusCode`). The verifier imports the same function in place of its private copy. At the child list query it asks `doorAnswersItself`, which reads the `/data` door's own classifier, `mapDataError` from `@objectstack/types` (new as a dependency of this package). Before this change the doors classified that read's throw themselves, so the executor asks them rather than keeping a second reader (seat ruling, REWORK 7193191377 S2). The door answers a throw itself unless its answer is the anonymous fault: status 500, `Internal server error`, coded `INTERNAL_ERROR` or not coded, and nothing else (REWORK 7195238190 S3).
- **A refusal answers as before.** At the object-level sites a coded refusal stays `PERMISSION_DENIED` 403 within the naming bound; a disabled package's `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` (404, coded) is such a refusal. At the child list query, a throw the door answers itself is rethrown untouched, exactly as on `main`, with its own code and sentence. A sandboxed `beforeFind` hook's plain throw stays `400 HOOK_ABORTED` in the hook's words, and a `PERMISSION_DENIED` with no status stays the door's `PERMISSION_DENIED`. A fault the door codes stays the door's answer too: an unavailable datasource stays `ERR_DATASOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` 503 with its sentence (the caller keeps the retry signal), a driver error the door recognises stays `DATABASE_ERROR`, a driver's declared `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` stays 501, and a declared 5xx keeps its code and the sentence or `userMessage` its producer declared. `INTERNAL_ERROR` 500 applies there to an uncoded failure only.
- **What an uncoded failure answers, and what it logs.** The code is `INTERNAL_ERROR` 500, not `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` 503. With a 5xx, `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` is on `CAPABILITY_ABSENCE_CODES` (`packages/types/src/server-fault-log.ts`), and the doors' fault line logs that code once per route per process, at `warn`, without the error (record 7193179486, M1). With `INTERNAL_ERROR`, each door logs the failure at `error` on every call. The fault line prints an error's message and stack and never its `cause` (both the console sink and `ObjectLogger`), so the failure's stack ends in `Caused by:` plus the original's stack. The original is also on `cause` for an in-process host; the verifier hands it to `onError`. A stack never reaches the wire.
- **What an MCP caller sees for an uncoded failure (S1).** On either door the caller gets `{ code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', status: 500 }` with the message `Internal server error`. The doors withhold a 5xx's own sentence, so the executor's `readFailed` sentence (en and zh-Hans; it names the pack and the root only) is read in-process only. Measured on `mapDataError`: the answer is `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` `Internal server error` whatever `cause` holds. Tried with no cause, a plain error, a SQLite and a Postgres unique violation, `SQLITE_BUSY`, and a coded 403.
- `verify-citations.ts`: the docblock paragraph that this change made false is rewritten (claim amendment 7192997436).

### ADR-0160 (card item 3)

No ADR-0160 sentence fixes 403 for a failed read. The two sentences closest are about refusals only:

> Every such refusal carries one code — `PERMISSION_DENIED`, the code #35145 uses — so the code does not tell a hidden object from a refused one. (D4, "The naming bound")

> An object-level refusal names the refused object only when the caller's served schema shows it, and every such refusal carries one code. (point 12)

D3 "Object level" covers refusals by gates and says nothing on reads that fail. So no ADR text has to change for this PR; whether to add a sentence on failures stays with #37490.

## Tests

- `record-context-tools.test.ts` has a new `describe`, "a read of a related object that fails is a failure, not a refusal". It has one uncoded-throw case per site: 500, the exact `readFailed` sentence, none of the outage's names, the original on `cause`, and `Caused by:` plus the original's stack in the failure's stack. It has a refusal control per object-level site (`OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` 404 stays `PERMISSION_DENIED` 403, unnamed) and for the child query (a coded refusal is rethrown unchanged). For S2: a sandboxed hook's plain throw (`innerMessage`) and a status-less `PERMISSION_DENIED` at the child query are rethrown untouched, while the same throws at an object-level read fail the call. A sandboxed body that crashed (a native error name) is a fault at the door, so it fails the call. At an object-level read, a driver errno with no status, a coded 5xx, a status with no code, and a thrown string are failures too. For S3, at the child query: an unavailable datasource (503), a driver error the door answers `DATABASE_ERROR`, a declared `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` 501, and a declared 5xx with its sentence or a `userMessage` are rethrown as the same object; each case first asserts the door's own answer for it (`mapDataError`). The controls there (a status-less 500, a coded `INTERNAL_ERROR` 500, an errno the door does not recognise, a thrown string), which the door answers with nothing of its own, fail the call. The sentence follows the caller's locale.
- `verify-citations.test.ts`: an uncoded throw at the child's served-definition read drops the citation and is reported once through `onError` (500, cause is the outage). A coded refusal there drops it and reports nothing. A control verifies the same citation.
- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts` is the real-kernel harness, run on both doors. Outage: the related-list read of `rc_revision` throws an uncoded error in `engine.find`. Asked twice, there are four `[5xx] 500` error lines (two doors times two calls), each carrying `INTERNAL_ERROR` and `Caused by: Error: OUTAGE_TEXT` (the thrown outage) in its stack, and no capability-absence warning. Both doors answer the same bytes, `INTERNAL_ERROR` 500, with no object name and no outage text. S2, at the same read: a sandboxed hook's plain throw answers `HOOK_ABORTED` 400 in the hook's words, and a status-less `PERMISSION_DENIED` answers `PERMISSION_DENIED` and never a 5xx. S3, at the same read: an `ERR_DATASOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` throw answers `ERR_DATASOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` 503 with its sentence on both doors, each door logs one `[5xx] 503` line, and no line carries `INTERNAL_ERROR`. Each case has a control that reads once the spy is removed.

## Acceptance notes

- A refusal the door answers at the child list query is rethrown as on `main`, so the citation verifier still reports a status-less one (`PERMISSION_DENIED` with no status, or a hook abort with no code) through `onError`, as it did on `main`. The verifier's rule (a string `code` plus a declared 4xx) is unchanged.
- The naming-probe read inside the step 4a exposure catch (`servedObjectDefinitionOf(...).catch(() => null)`) still treats a throw as "not shown". The refusal is a real one, so a throw there only leaves out the object's name.
- Every uncoded failure is `INTERNAL_ERROR` 500, a bug included (N2 is accepted by the seat).
- The child query's predicate asks the classifier with the child's name, where the door asks with the root's; only the classifier's name-dependent 404 arm reads it (N3, accepted by the seat).

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `record-context-tools.ts`: `refusedOrFailed`, the four `catch` sites that call it, and `doorAnswersItself`, the child list query's predicate.
2. `record-context-tools.ts` `isCodedRefusal`, and `verify-citations.ts` importing it.
3. `packages/services/service-record-context/package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`: one workspace dependency, `@objectstack/types`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-record-context exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/record-context-tools.test.ts`. Expect the new `describe` to pass, every case.

Readings at head `007615908a` (this container, shared box):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-record-context test` + `typecheck`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 174 passed (174); tsc clean; check:test-typecheck OK. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (whole suite): Test Files 649 passed (649), Tests 12065 passed, 25 skipped. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation S3, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the child list query's predicate reverted to the round-2 line, "the door answers below 500" (blob 756d30378a88 to cb3d0801619c), rebuilt, marker present in dist (preflight exit 0). Service 5 failed / 145 passed (the five coded-fault cases), harness 1 failed / 27 passed (the `ERR_DATASOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` case: the answer was `INTERNAL_ERROR`). Restore leg: blob back to 756d30378a88, equal to HEAD; `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt; marker absent (preflight `--absent` exit 0); 150/150 and 28/28 pass.
- The round-2 ablations (M1, S2) were run at `bd03a37ed8` and not rerun at this head; this commit changes only the child query's predicate. There, M1 failed the harness at the fault-line pin and S2 failed all four S2 cases.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 83 derived, 82 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs every package's dist). The derivation warned the tree is 23 commits behind `origin/main` with 7 gate files changed there; CI runs the current gates.
- Overlap check: VERDICT clean (`origin/main`, #37442 on `pnpm-lock.yaml`, #35129 on `package.json`).
- CI on `007615908a`: 69 check-runs, 60 success, 9 skipped, 0 failure. Every required context is green, the UI ones and Check Changeset included.
